title: RelicTech: Core Loop
summary: Identify relic behavior, test safely, preserve charges, and store notes with the item.

blocks.title: Repeatable Loop
blocks.body: Find relics, identify them, charge or stabilize them, use them for targeted advantages, and repair or cool them down before the next major route.

blocks.title: Pressure Check
blocks.body: After each test, record cost, trigger, benefit, danger, and recovery plan. A relic you understand is a tool; one you rush is a liability.

blocks.title: Stop Point
blocks.body: Stop testing before charges, durability, or consequences become unclear. Bring the relic home and compare notes before the next attempt.

blocks.title: Loop Check
blocks.body: Run the loop once more only if the return path, inventory space, and next upgrade are clear.
